Celebrate Durga Puja with 5 delicious Bengali recipes! From crispy Puchka and Mochar Chop to traditional Radha Ballavi, rich Kosha Mangsho and Kolkata-style Chicken Kathi Roll, these recipes bring the authentic flavours of Bengal to your festive celebrations. Enjoy the perfect mix of street food favourites and traditional Bengali delicacies.
Best cooked in Wonderchef Kitchenware.
